list: Official PS5 trophy list: 55 trophies (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze); 28 hidden until earned; 0 online trophies. Names, descriptions and grades as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase and cross-checked against the guides below. Checked 2026-11-20.

meta.cheats: Using cheats disables trophies and saving.
meta.free_roam_after_story: Yes: after the credits you keep free-roaming Leonida and everything needed for 100% is still reachable.
meta.mission_replay: None: missions cannot be replayed, so keep manual saves at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual save slots).

roadmap.text: Just play the story and enjoy it. All 12 story trophies pop as you finish chapters and missions, and nothing else in this stage can lock you out of the platinum — except one thing: the first meditation. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation. It may be the only missable trophy in the game, and nobody has confirmed yet whether it is actually required. While you play, scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with the binoculars: both count toward the 100% checklist later.
roadmap.title: Play the story — Chapters 1–5

roadmap.text: After the credits, the 100% Completion Checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is far more forgiving than it sounds — roughly 60% of true completion. You need any 100 optional missions, any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied, any 70 of 80 challenges, all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests, but only 15 of 18 meditations. Most trophies in this guide fall in this stage; do them in whatever order you like.
roadmap.title: 100% Completion Checklist

roadmap.text: Strangers & Freaks are not needed for 100%, so finish the 8 qualifying strands now, then sweep up whatever is left — the last challenges, the last card set, the last garage. Check the in-game Progress menu (Touchpad > Progress) for exact counts on every activity.
roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks and clean-up

roadmap.text: Vice Got a Price! pops the moment the other 54 are done. No multiplayer, no DLC and no second playthrough are needed.
roadmap.title: Platinum

List cross-check; Positive Mental Attitude as the only possibly missable trophy; cheats disable trophies.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. There is no extra task: the platinum is the reward for finishing everything else. The longest road to it is A Long Road, the gold for 100% completion, so plan around the roadmap stages above rather than chasing this trophy directly.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Finish the story (stage 1).
Clear the 100% Completion Checklist (stage 2).
Finish the Strangers & Freaks strands and any leftovers (stage 3).
trophies.when: Last trophy you will earn, after about 200 hours.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1, where you play as Jason. Just follow the mission prompts; there is nothing to prepare and no way to fail it permanently.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start the game and play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
trophies.when: Chapter 1, first mission.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when the last mission of Chapter 1 ends and Chapter 2 begins. Keep a manual save at the end of the chapter anyway — missions cannot be replayed, and a save per chapter is cheap insurance for the whole run.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play through every main mission of Chapter 1.
trophies.when: End of Chapter 1.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish Chapter 2. From this chapter on you can switch between Jason and Lucia after the mission Coffee Break, which opens up the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) and the character questlines.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play through every main mission of Chapter 2.
trophies.when: End of Chapter 2.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish Chapter 3. This is the chapter where several side systems unlock — Andy's questline for Lucia, Randy's car wish list, the Key Cloner — so it is a good moment to start the side content listed in stage 2.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play through every main mission of Chapter 3.
trophies.when: End of Chapter 3.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish Chapter 4. The final chapter follows; the optional mission That's Where The Money Is in this chapter introduces the large bank vault robberies that the Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play trophies need.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play through every main mission of Chapter 4.
trophies.when: End of Chapter 4.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when the final mission ends and the credits roll. After it, the game returns you to free-roam Leonida and unlocks the 100% Completion Checklist under Progress > Stats, so the clean-up phase of the platinum run starts here.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Play through the final mission of the story.
trophies.when: End of the story (Chapter 5).

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Breakfast Run is a main mission in Chapter 2; finish it and the trophy pops at the mission's end. Like all story trophies it needs no preparation — just keep playing the main missions in order.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the main mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.
trophies.when: Chapter 2.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. The Cartel Heist is a main mission in Chapter 3; finish it and the trophy pops. No side preparation is needed, and the mission stays available until you play it — story missions never expire.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play the main mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
trophies.when: Chapter 3.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Child's Play is a main mission in Chapter 4; finish it and the trophy pops. Keep playing the story and it will come to you.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the main mission Child's Play in Chapter 4.
trophies.when: Chapter 4.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Headliners is a main mission in Chapter 4; finish it and the trophy pops. No preparation needed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the main mission Headliners in Chapter 4.
trophies.when: Chapter 4.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. VCIA Takedown is a main mission in Chapter 4, set at Vice City International Airport; finish it and the trophy pops. It also introduces the airport grounds that the Catch Me If You Can trophy later uses.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the main mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
trophies.when: Chapter 4.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Operation Savage Glory is a main mission in Chapter 5; finish it and the trophy pops. It is one of the last story trophies before the final mission.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the main mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
trophies.when: Chapter 5.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the bulk of the platinum run. The 100% Completion Checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress you made during the story already counts. It is far more forgiving than a true 100%: roughly 60% of everything in the game. You need any 100 optional missions, any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied, any 70 of 80 challenges, all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests — but only 15 of 18 meditations. Most of it comes free while you earn the other trophies; use the in-game checklist itself as your to-do list.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story to unlock the checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion).
Work through the checklist categories; skip the hardest 10 of 80 challenges.
Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars as you travel.
trophies.when: After the story; the longest single stage, about 100 hours.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida (the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going after this pops). There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps. Mix them freely — the count is shared — and pick the easiest: flying under bridges is the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where each stunt has its own name and stays marked once done.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Open the map, filter Exploration > Stunt Spots, and pick a cluster near you.
Do stunt jumps and under-bridge flights first — they are the fastest.
Check Progress > Activities > Stunts for your total; stop at 250 (300 for 100%).
trophies.when: Any time after the story opens the map up; best done in free-roam.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. The game tracks them under Touchpad > Progress > Activities — scroll over each type to see how many you have done. You will be introduced to most of them by the story, and the rest appear as blue dumbbell icons when you unfog the map, so this usually pops on its own while you work on the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see which types are still at zero.
Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) and visit the missing ones.
One try each is enough — no wins or scores needed except where the type itself is a race.
trophies.when: Any time; usually completes itself during the other trophies.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 shooting range locations. The gold-medal scores are not punishing, and the ranges also level up your Focus, which helps the Gunslinger trophy. Work through them range by range; a dedicated location guide lists every range if you want to tick them off in order.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Find a shooting range (12 locations across Leonida).
Play each challenge until you hit the gold-medal score.
Repeat at every range until all 42 golds are earned.
trophies.when: Stage 2; also required in full for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total). You only need one win per location, not every race. Drone races are also one of the activity types for Master of None and are required in full for the 100% checklist, so treat this as the first pass of a longer job.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location on the map.
Win one race there — repeat the easiest race at that location if you lose.
Move to the next location until all 14 are won.
trophies.when: Stage 2; available from early on, best done in free-roam.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so you have twice as many to choose from as you need — pick the short, easy ones and skip any that give you trouble. Winning a race also counts toward the race activity type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Find race locations on the map (40 unique spots).
Win a race at 20 different locations — each location counts once.
Use a fast car you are comfortable with; retrying the same location does not add to the count.
trophies.when: Stage 2.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Some time after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he sends a text that marks a fishing location with a purple icon on the map, west of Key Lento. Go there and beat him in the fishing challenge. It is a short, self-contained quest — no special rod or skill level is needed.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Play past Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (meet Cal).
Wait for Cal's text, then follow the purple icon west of Key Lento.
Win the fishing challenge against Cal.
trophies.when: Chapter 1 onward; quest stays available after the story.

trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home — interact with the controllers — and you can already do this in Chapter 1. Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game once; beating every challenge inside it is not required. Pick whichever game you enjoy most.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Go to the TV at home (or an arcade machine for Bang For Your Buck).
Pick one of the 4 games and play through all of its levels.
Reaching the end once is enough — no challenge medals needed.
trophies.when: Chapter 1 onward; also doable after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia. While playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address, which marks the questline in Belville. Complete all 5 of her quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last one. Every quest stays available after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 until Andy calls and texts her address.
Follow the markers in Belville and complete her 5 quests in order.
The trophy pops after Puff Puff Pass, the final mission.
trophies.when: Chapter 3 onward, Lucia only; available after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1. A while after the mission Island Dreams, where you work for him, he calls you and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure diving: he marks purple treasure chest icons on the map, you find the underwater treasures with the metal detector and bring them back. In total he wants 7 shipwrecks cleared, in sets — after the first set he calls you back for more. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable in later chapters but returns, so nothing here is missable; you can hurry his return by calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Play past Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams, then answer Kenton's call.
Dive the marked shipwrecks and bring the treasures back to his shop in Key Lento.
Clear all 7 shipwrecks across his quest sets.
trophies.when: Chapter 1 onward; Kenton returns in later chapters if he goes quiet.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his 5 quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops after the last one. All of his quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Play past Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
Go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County and take Billy's quests.
Complete all 5 quests, ending with Hometown Heroes.
trophies.when: Chapter 2 onward; available after the story.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Strangers & Freaks are side quests you find in the open world — but not every optional questline counts. Questlines for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy; only certain stranger strands do. Confirmed ones so far: Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing and mentoring), and Pilot Pete (package deliveries) — with more strangers still being found. You can see your count in the trophy tracker in the trophy list. Everything stays available after the story, so save this for the clean-up stage.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Look for stranger markers in the open world after the story.
Complete full strands — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count.
Watch the trophy tracker until 8 strands are done.
trophies.when: Clean-up stage (stage 3); all strands stay available after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then gives you a list of 16 sports cars to deliver. He marks some cars for you in fixed locations, but you can steal any of them off the street — scan a high-end sports car with the WAiNK app to see if it is on the list, then drive it back to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Delivering a car in good condition pays more. Sports cars are commonest in east Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around. This can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Play past Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs to unlock the Key Cloner.
Take Randy's wish list of 16 sports cars.
Steal and deliver each car to Randy's garage; scan cars with WAiNK to check the list.
trophies.when: Chapter 3 onward; fully doable after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is only available as Jason. Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go there and destroy them as part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This, and finishing it pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Play as Jason past Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty.
Destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in Vice City (Take Out Kitty Litter).
Complete Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This.
trophies.when: Chapter 3 onward, Jason only; available after the story.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. You can meditate as both Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location, and you can track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE WARNING: the first meditation can only be done in Chapter 1 at Jason's house, and it becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate — follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. Do it the moment it appears; keep a manual save from Chapter 1 just in case. It is still unconfirmed whether this one is actually required for the trophy (it raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a meditation spot), and the 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 — but the safe play is to do it. You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: CHAPTER 1 — after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and accept the balcony meditation. Do not leave Chapter 1 without it.
Visit all 18 meditation spots across Leonida (10 locations).
Meditate at each spot with both Jason and Lucia where possible.
trophies.when: START IN CHAPTER 1 — the house meditation is the only possibly missable trophy in the game.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline is marked automatically some time after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Playing as Jason, you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive the message — this line is Jason-only). Do the quest and he starts marking hunting spots with purple icons. Hunt the animals he requests and bring them back to him. During the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. One clean shot leaves an animal pristine and pays more, but it is not required for the quest. The exact animal that pops the trophy is still being confirmed, and his quests overlap with the 15 Target Decks the 100% checklist needs, so keep hunting.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Play as Jason past Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
Answer Bret's text and meet him in Lummox County (Veteran Hunted).
Hunt the animals he marks and bring them back to him.
trophies.when: Chapter 2 onward, Jason only; available after the story.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card sets in total, so you only need a sixth of them — pick the sets whose cards cluster near each other and leave the scattered ones alone. A set guide with every card location makes this a quick sweep once you have a car and the map unfogged.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Pick 3 of the 18 card sets to complete.
Collect every card of those sets (use a set location guide).
The trophy pops when the third set is complete.
trophies.when: Stage 2; best done once you can drive anywhere freely.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations by holding Up and then R1 while looking at them. There are far more than 100 in the world, so any 100 will do: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags. The same WAiNK app scans vehicles for the Whip It Good trophy and the 100% checklist, so scan everything you walk past and this fills up on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up for a quick scan).
Scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags as you explore.
Any 100 scans count — you do not need all of them.
trophies.when: Any time; builds up naturally while exploring.

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. There are eight groups of ten, and you can view and track them under Progress > Challenges (the checkmark in the bottom right shows what is done). The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so you get 10 free skips for the hardest ones — this trophy pops automatically along the way. Many challenges complete naturally while you work on the other trophies; leave this for last, then pick the easiest remaining ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Check Progress > Challenges for what you have already done.
Play normally — most challenges finish while doing other trophies.
At the end, pick the easiest remaining challenges to reach 50 (70 for 100%).
trophies.when: Late stage 2; pops on the way to the 70 needed for 100%.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: First unlock partner free-roam after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Then build a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you and escape the red heat zone — the trophy pops once you drive out of it, not when you leave the flashing search area. The easiest escape is a fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic; if a helicopter chases you, shoot it down. A reliable route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. You will also get this automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, and again while robbing the large bank vaults, which always trigger 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: After Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Cause chaos until you reach a 4-star wanted level.
Escape the red heat zone — try the train tunnel north of Ambrosia.
trophies.when: Chapter 2 onward; often pops by itself during bank vault robberies.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can call your partner (hold Right + Triangle). Then rob 3 robbery targets (green icons) in a row while staying wanted the whole time — keep the flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. Loot a couple of items in each store and ideally break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. The unlock is delayed: it pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop, and if it does not, hit a fourth shop and keep going.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner and gear up (vest, sticky bombs, healing).
Rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level.
Wait ~30 seconds after leaving the third shop; if it does not pop, rob a fourth.
trophies.when: Chapter 2 onward; jewelry stores in north Vice City work well.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Leonida has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes), and discovering only means scanning: open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to use it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. You do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this pops automatically on the way there. Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan vehicles with R1.
Scan on busy roads — every new vehicle counts, driving it is not needed.
Stop at 100 (200 base models for 100%).
trophies.when: Any time; pops on the way to the 200 scans for 100%.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is activated with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots on enemies are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar under your health and stamina. You must kill or incapacitate 5 enemies in one single use, and focus only lasts a few seconds — so prepare first. Eat or drink to buff focus, wash your face or shower at home, and consume Adrenaline (hold L1, then Triangle) to extend it. Then line up 5 enemies — criminals at gang operations work well — and drop them fast without missing, ideally with an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover. Note that it reportedly does not count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus); it grows by doing shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game — you will likely be Focus level 4 by then.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Buff focus: eat/drink, wash up, and take Adrenaline before the fight.
Find 5 grouped enemies (gang operations are ideal) and wear body armor.
Aim, trigger Combat Focus (L3 + R3) and drop all 5 in one use.
trophies.when: Stage 2; easier at Focus level 4, late in the game.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not the planes sitting on the airfield. The easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight to the plane, and next to the boarding bridge there are stairs with a door leading directly inside. Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the trophy is slightly delayed and pops once you are far enough out. You can also walk in through the terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA and drive through a fence onto the airfield.
Board the large plane docked at terminal E3/E4 (via the stairs by the boarding bridge).
Enter the cockpit, reverse to the strip, take off and fly 1 km away.
trophies.when: Any time you can reach the airport; free-roam is easiest.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino) and the trophy pops once you start using it. The tanks stand at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate — or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance — get into a tank in the south of the base and shoot some enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Travel to Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County (south-west island).
Enter the base through the gate or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Climb into a Rhino tank in the south of the base and fire at enemies.
trophies.when: Any time; easiest in free-roam with a fast approach vehicle.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. That unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies — they appear with a green icon on unfogged map areas. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun (the gadget stays in your inventory; when you approach a locked door you get the choice to kick it, which triggers the alarm, or use the Snap Gun for the stealth approach). Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Finish Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun — never kick the door.
Loot the safe with the code from the note, destroy the footage, disable the alarm, then leave.
trophies.when: Chapter 3 onward.

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress and introduces bank vault robberies: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then a guard carries a briefcase of cash inside and the vault opens — slip in while it is open and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash alone, so bring your partner and hand off a bag (hold Right). After that quest, pay Yasmani — the fence from Chapter 3 — for tips about security vans ($10,000 each; finish his earlier Payday Loans robberies first if you have not). Each vault robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and you need any 5 here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, so you will earn this automatically. Each vault pays up to $205,000 — the best money in the endgame.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Finish Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (your first vault).
Buy security-van tips from Yasmani ($10,000) to find more vaults.
Rob 5 vaults and escape each time (8 total for 100%).
trophies.when: Chapter 4 onward; also the best endgame money.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is — the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies. Robbing a large bank's vault counts as robbing an armored truck: you tail the truck to the bank, the guard carries the cash to the vault, you slip in, steal it and escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). Since the 100% checklist needs all 8 large bank jobs, you will get this without trying. To get it earlier, block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — it only pops after you escape the heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his jobs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Play the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is — it counts automatically.
Or: stop an armored truck near a bank, sticky-bomb its back door, loot it.
Escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray) to pop it.
trophies.when: Chapter 4 onward; automatic during the bank-vault questline.

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. Do it in a long sweep over the state rather than driving — a plane covers ground far faster, and you will pass over the coast, the islands and the inland counties in one trip. A dedicated unfogging guide names a good plane and route if you want the quickest path.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Get a plane (any flyable aircraft will do).
Fly over every black-fogged area of the map until it is all visible.
Check the map: no fog left anywhere means the trophy pops.
trophies.when: Stage 2; quickest once you have a plane.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, and the 100% checklist needs all 39 — so this pops on the way there. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track them under Progress > Gangs: scroll over a gang and the bottom right shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Watch for yellow operation icons on the map as you travel.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs (any 9 of the 39).
Track progress under Progress > Gangs.
trophies.when: Stage 2; pops on the way to all 39 for 100%.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar and the trophy pops. That is the whole job — a one-minute trophy once you know the bar. It is hidden on PlayStation, so its name and description give nothing away until you earn it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini.
Drink it while standing next to the bar.
trophies.when: Any time; a one-minute trophy.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal a specific car from a specific showroom and drive it straight through the showroom window. The car is the blue Banshee in the showroom in the south of Vice City. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs — hack into the car, drive forward and straight through the window. The pop is slightly delayed and comes once you are further down the street. Only this blue Banshee counts, not any other car: it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Finish Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs to get the Key Cloner.
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City.
Hack the blue Banshee, then drive it straight through the showroom window.
trophies.when: Chapter 3 onward.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations. Buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first: you need them to blow open the safe. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. Inside, pick up the luxury watch in the south-east office (golden icon), the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner (golden icon), and loot the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it up with sticky bombs). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item, and killing the enemies is not required. If you miss an item during the mission, do not worry: the robbery icon respawns after a long while, so you can return and steal whatever is left — this trophy is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation.
During Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, grab the watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe loot.
Escape the police — the trophy pops after the escape, and leftovers can be grabbed on a later visit.
trophies.when: Chapter 2 onward; not missable even if you miss an item first time.

trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia (select a character, scroll to Strength, the heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club, and always go together with both characters (hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner): while one works out, the other automatically completes their training too, so you make double progress. Filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities (dumbbell icon); there are many across Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: After Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, buy a fitness club membership.
Always train with both characters together (call your partner first).
Repeat until both are at maximum strength at the same time.
trophies.when: Chapter 2 onward; grind it in stage 2.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. You can see your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): whenever you do something that affects your reputation, a little demon face appears on the right of the screen. Finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence and clean escapes push you toward Professional; incapacitating enemies without killing them is Hardened; killing enemies and civilians is Violent; killing large numbers of cops and civilians or driving over gravestones is Psycho. This happens passively — every robbery and enemy encounter counts — so you will very likely get it while working on the other trophies. If it is still missing at the end, it can be farmed quickly by running over civilians and cops with a car. One caution: the Irredeemable profile is permanent, and at Psycho or Irredeemable cops are more likely to shoot you on sight.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications).
Play normally — robberies, escapes and fights all count.
Check the trophy's counter in the trophy list; farm the last few with a car if needed.
trophies.when: Passive; usually pops during stage 2. Avoid the permanent Irredeemable profile.

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has pinned this one down yet. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue: possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner (the store is in Little Cuba, Vice City). Do not go out of your way for it until a guide confirms the method; check the PowerPyx guide again before your clean-up stage, and treat anything else you read about it as a rumor until two sources agree.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Wait for a confirmed method — currently unconfirmed by every major guide.
The leading guess: the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba, robbed a second time.
Re-check the cited guides during clean-up before chasing it.
trophies.when: Unconfirmed; check back before the clean-up stage.

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and go alone. It is slightly random and not a guaranteed spawn: sometimes you will find a blinking car at the roadside. If the car is not there, drive away and come back later. When it is there, follow the path next to it into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted; talk to her and offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside as she asks — the trophy pops when you do.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Go alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel, Kelly County, after 2AM.
Look for the blinking car; if it is not there, leave and return later.
Follow the path into the woods, approach the UFO, help the woman it drops, and return to her car.
trophies.when: Any night after 2AM; the spawn is random, so it may take a few tries.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it somewhere crowded — Vice City streets or Ocean Beach — where pedestrians are packed together, and keep moving so you always have a new target in reach. Ten kicks in a minute is generous once you are rolling through a crowd.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get on any bike and ride to a crowded area (Vice City or Ocean Beach).
Kick pedestrians with Square as you ride past them.
Land 10 kicks within 60 seconds.
trophies.when: Any time; easiest in a busy pedestrian area.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 counts across all robberies; you do not need to bring it in one trip. This comes naturally while you do all robberies for the 100% checklist, and bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery once they unlock after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Finish Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Deliver $250,000 total to a fence (Yasmani pays the most).
trophies.when: Chapter 3 onward; pops naturally during robbery clean-up.

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. The fastest way is to buy the expensive things: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods at mod shops, and tattoos. Everything counts — clothing, footwear, hair and beauty, electronics, Pay 'n' Spray visits — so this fills up on its own as you kit out your characters and cars. There are 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores to spend it in.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Buy guns, car mods and tattoos first — they are the most expensive.
Keep spending across any shops until the $100,000 total is reached.
Check your spending in the game stats if you want the exact figure.
trophies.when: Any time; usually pops while buying gear for other trophies.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are 4 more story-related garages that do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages become available for purchase after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when you get a notification that a new app — Vice City Real Estate — has been installed on your phone. Buy them through the phone app. Robberies are the quickest way to make the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4. Garages also add parking spots, which you need for the On the Spot trophy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Finish Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app.
Earn $160,000 (robberies are fastest).
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the phone app.
trophies.when: Chapter 2 onward; buy them as you can afford them.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location anywhere. To register 10 vehicles you first need enough garages — each garage adds one or more parking spots, so buy garages (see Little Boxes) before you start. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, and in his garage choose Respray and then Register. He only accepts vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers, and register them at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Finish Chapter 2 mission Moses to unlock the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garages first — each one adds parking spots for registrations.
Drive cheap stolen cars or bikes to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register (10 times).
trophies.when: Chapter 2 onward; buy garages first.
